List the packages of a repository, or the versions of one package

List the packages of a repository, 100 per request. With coordinates, list the
next level down: the versions of a package, the artifacts of a Maven group,
the tags of a Docker image (image) or the manifests of a tag (image:tag).

--search keeps the names that contain the text (case-insensitive); a few lists
have no such filter and say so. --limit stops after that many rows; 0 (the
default) reads them all. Lists the server does not page, such as npm and Helm
tags, are in "rp package tags".

Packages are named in the natural coordinates of the repository's format:

```
maven   group[:artifact[:version]]        com.acme:app:1.2.0
npm     [@scope/]name[@version]           @acme/ui@2.0.0   (@acme alone: a scope)
docker  image[:tag] | image@digest        team/app:1.0     (image may contain "/")
go      module/path[@version]             example.com/mod@v1.2.3
cargo, helm, nuget, pypi, ruby   name[@version]
```

The format is read from the repository; pass --format to skip that request.

--output json prints the API fields of each row.

```
rp package list [coordinates] [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --format string   Repository format (default: read from the repository)
      --limit int       Stop after this many rows (0 means all)
      --repo string     Repository name (required)
      --search string   Only rows whose name contains this text
```
